Appendix B

Appendix B, Index, About the Author附录 B、索引与关于作者

This book covers all objectives relevant to the exam and more. The tables in this appendix map the exam objective to the corresponding book chapter. You will also find a reference to the Kubernetes documentation. Some foundational objectives important to the exam, such as Pods and namespaces, have not been listed explicitly in the curriculum; however, the book does cover them. Use the mapping as a reference to review specific objectives in more detail.

本书覆盖了考试相关的全部大纲，甚至更多。本附录中的表格把考试目标映射到本书对应章节，并给出 Kubernetes 文档的参考链接。一些对考试很重要的基础目标（例如 Pod 和命名空间）并未在大纲中显式列出，但本书同样有覆盖。可以借助这张映射表，有针对性地复习具体目标。

The following index lists the key English terms used throughout the book together with their page numbers. Page numbers are kept in English order; a short Chinese gloss is given for each term to help locate the right topic.

下面的索引列出全书关键英文术语及其页码。页码保持原书顺序；每个术语附一句中文释义，便于定位主题。

About the Author关于作者

Benjamin Muschko is a software engineer, consultant, and trainer with more than 20 years of experience in the industry. He's passionate about project automation, testing, and continuous delivery. Ben is an author and an avid open source advocate. He is a Kubestronaut, holding all Kubernetes certifications.

Benjamin Muschko 是一位软件工程师、顾问和培训师，在行业内拥有 20 多年经验。他热衷于项目自动化、测试和持续交付。Ben 是一位作家，也是坚定的开源倡导者。他是 Kubestronaut，持有全部 Kubernetes 认证。

Software projects sometimes feel like climbing a mountain. In his free time, Ben loves hiking Colorado's 14ers and enjoys conquering long-distance trails.

软件项目有时就像登山。业余时间，Ben 喜欢攀登科罗拉多州海拔 14000 英尺以上的山峰，也爱征服长距离徒步路线。

Colophon版权页说明

The animal on the cover of Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) Study Guide is a Bengal eagle owl (Bubo bengalensis), also known as the Indian eagle owl. They are a large horned-owl species native to the Indian subcontinent.

本书封面动物是一只孟加拉雕鸮（Bubo bengalensis），也称印度雕鸮。它们是一种大型角鸮，原生分布于印度次大陆。

Bengal eagle owls are very similar to Eurasian eagle owls and may actually be a subspecies. They have a mixture of brown, gray, black, and white feathers. They favor forests and rocky areas with scrub and brush. Their diet is primarily rodents and birds.

孟加拉雕鸮与欧亚雕鸮非常相似，实际上可能是后者的一个亚种。它们的羽毛混合棕、灰、黑、白四色，偏好森林和有灌丛的多岩地带，主食啮齿动物和鸟类。

The owls breed from November to April, with females laying 2 to 4 eggs that incubate for about 35 days. The nest site is on the ground and is reused from year to year. As with other owls, Bengal eagle owls are nocturnal and known for their night calls. They are considered birds of ill omen, and it is said that when their calls are delivered from high above, the call foretells death.

这种猫头鹰的繁殖期为 11 月到次年 4 月，雌鸟产 2 到 4 枚卵，孵化约 35 天。巢筑于地面，年年复用。和其他猫头鹰一样，孟加拉雕鸮夜间活动，以夜间鸣叫著称。它们被视为不祥之鸟，据说若从高空传来其鸣声，便预示死亡将至。

The Bengal eagle owl's conservation status is Least Concern. Many of the animals on O'Reilly covers are endangered; all of them are important to the world.

孟加拉雕鸮的保护级别为“无危”。O'Reilly 封面上的许多动物属于濒危物种，而它们每一个对这个世界都很重要。

The cover illustration is by Karen Montgomery, based on an antique line engraving from British Birds. The series design is by Edie Freedman, Ellie Volckhausen, and Karen Montgomery. The cover fonts are Gilroy Semibold and Guardian Sans. The text font is Adobe Minion Pro; the heading font is Adobe Myriad Condensed; and the code font is Dalton Maag's Ubuntu Mono.

封面插图由 Karen Montgomery 绘制，素材取自《英国鸟类》古籍线刻。系列装帧由 Edie Freedman、Ellie Volckhausen 和 Karen Montgomery 设计。封面字体为 Gilroy Semibold 与 Guardian Sans；正文字体为 Adobe Minion Pro；标题字体为 Adobe Myriad Condensed；代码字体为 Dalton Maag 的 Ubuntu Mono。
